title: Generator objective saturates and provides weak gradients early in training
description: Early in learning, when the generator is poor, the discriminator rejects samples with high confidence, causing log(1-D(G(z))) to saturate and provide insufficient gradient for the generator to learn.
canonical_description: generator objective saturates and provides insufficient gradient signal early in adversarial training

evidence.quote: In practice, equation [REF] may not provide sufficient gradient for G to learn well. Early in learning, when G is poor, D can reject samples with high confidence because they are clearly different from the training data. In this case, log(1-D(G(z))) saturates.
